title: RuCL: Stratified Rubric-Based Curriculum Learning for Multimodal Large Language Model Reasoning
reasoning: The paper focuses on a curriculum learning framework (RuCL) to improve reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models. While it includes a evaluation rubric for 'External Bias' (stereotypes) and a section on safety-related robustness (EvadeBench), these are auxiliary metrics for the primary goal of enhancing mathematical and logical reasoning, and the paper does not specifically evaluate religion, faith, or ethics as a core component.
